open_questions: msg_s full layout (bit cursor, allowoverflow/oob flags, total size) is not recovered; only offsets 0x00-0x10 are observed here. Confirm against MSG_Init in the msg lane.
fn_08067ece is read as MSG_ReadBit (used as the removed flag and unchanged flag in the delta readers); fn_08067d28/fn_08067d86 are WriteBit0/WriteBit1. These are inferred from call structure only.

Read-side integer paths of MSG_ReadDeltaPlayerState are translated as raw int bits. Ghidra types them as float; the write side was verified in disassembly (raw loads, sar shifts). The read-side low-bits and shift sequence should be confirmed by disassembly.
netadr_s, and several chunk functions taking it, pass the 20-byte struct by value; the signatures show pointer forms. The merge lane should choose the by-value ABI.
NET_SendLoopPacket parameters 4 and 5 are never read; NET_SendPacket passes literal 2 for type and a zero ip. Confirm against other callers in the send path.
NET_IsLocalAddress receives the address by value; only the type dword is read.
Anim_ParseBlock parameter roles (emitDefaultVoid, loopsync, forceReset) are inferred from the "void"/"void_loop" strings and the flag tests. The anim lane should confirm the names.
Anim_HashAndEmitTree hash inputs (0x1f multiplier over base, index, leaf count and first key) need confirmation from the anim tree writer.
